risk_note: B2-02zc (BR-FUND-19 细则「账务自检异常」第 4 条, couli#9 / couli#12; 编排 D10-2219 / D10-2224 B ① / D10-2295 甲 / D10-2298 / D10-2318): migration 0152 adds the partial unique index recon_diffs_unresolved_internal_key (app_id, type, ref_id) WHERE type = 'ledger_mismatch' AND status IN ('open','processing') AND ref_type <> 'order' — account- and voucher-level self-check differences are not registered or held again on later accounting days while unresolved; order-level ones keep one per day (FU-B2-02ZC-ORDER-LEVEL-DEDUP). registerReconDiffOnce reads the unresolved ticket back after a conflict (inserted = false, no rewrite, no second hold). 0152 holds no DML (two SET LOCAL and one CREATE UNIQUE INDEX); existing duplicates make it fail with 23505 (fail closed; staging pre-check per D10-2275 ③).

reviews.note: Codex money r1 (full) fail: S1 order-level beneficiaries missed by the dedupe → D10-2295 甲 (ref_type <> 'order'); r2 fail: the one S1 was the planning conflict (BR-FUND-19 then had no order-level exception) → couli#12 merged, SPEC_REF c3060ba021c2 (#438); r3 incremental under approvals 126 (D10-2318 ②) pass, no findings: the conflict closed and 0152 verified to hold no DML (couli-runs/B2-02zc/review-money-r3-codex.json).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude (claude-run.sh, approvals 36): attempts 1–3, a 4th under approvals 124 and a 5th under approvals 125. Codex spec-test r1 / r2 / r3 / r4 each fail; their S1 were closed by the next attempt except the last ones, logged as FU-B2-02ZC-MIGRATION-SAME-USER-HOLDS (closed by attempt 5) and FU-B2-02ZC-ORDER-REPLAY-MIGRATION-STOCK (编排 D10-2297: regression guards for a hypothetical implementation, to be done with FU-B2-02ZC-ORDER-LEVEL-DEDUP). The ledger declares no red_exempt / rows / renames / expected_values, so evidence-check does not require a pass here (D10-2289 / D10-2290).

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
